authority_eol_hash_divergence.summary: Governed authority hashes differed between Git-archive LF bytes and inherited Windows working-tree bytes; explicit LF ownership is required.

bootstrap_programs_author_gold.summary: Bootstrap proposer output was selected as episode gold, so the proposal mechanism could author the semantic target used to train and score itself.

marker_only_realization_equivalence.summary: Marker, polarity and modality checks substituted for exact round-trip canonical-expression equivalence.

pointer_source_anonymization_collapses_m.summary: Entity and source-pointer anonymization could collapse role-reversed or otherwise pointer-distinct meanings during evaluation.

program_as_meaning.summary: Program ABI 1 construction derivations were treated as settled meaning, so verification, gold, cognition, hashing and realization compared procedures instead of canonical semantic expressions.

proposal_runtime_abi_divergence.summary: After ORIENT the proposal owner returns candidates while the inherited runtime reads program, output_refs and rejection_codes.
